title: Transformer-XL: Attentive Language Models beyond a Fixed-Length Context
summary: Zihang Dai, Zhilin Yang, Yiming Yang, Jaime Carbonell, Quoc V. Le, and Ruslan Salakhutdinov submitted 'Transformer-XL: Attentive Language Models beyond a Fixed-Length Context' on January 9, 2019. The paper proposes Transformer-XL, a neural architecture using a segment-level recurrence mechanism and a positional encoding scheme to model dependency beyond a fixed-length context.
significance: A documented language-model architecture milestone introducing Transformer-XL for learning dependencies beyond a fixed-length context.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the authors, January 9 2019 submission date, and the paper's description of Transformer-XL, including segment-level recurrence and a positional encoding scheme. The ACL Anthology independently corroborates the paper, authors, technical description, July 2019 conference publication, and pages 2978-2988. The day-precision date is attached only to the arXiv submission milestone and is not asserted as a universal architecture-invention, release, or system-birth date. No geography, institutional affiliation, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships are inferred.
